entries.title: Casual man
entries.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: SGMTS Game human character reference sheet for rebuilding a convincing 3D model.
Input image 1 is a LAYOUT, LIGHTING and PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM reference only. Do not copy that man's identity, khaki vest, headphones or outfit.
Create ONE high-resolution landscape studio character sheet, ideally 2400x1600 or larger. Neutral warm-light-grey seamless background, soft even diffuse studio illumination, restrained floor contact shadows, natural skin texture, realistic anatomy and cloth. This must look like photographic reference of a real fictional human, not a cartoon, voxel, low-poly model or plastic mannequin.
Layout: four clean panels with thin grey dividers. Left panel detailed head-and-shoulders frontal close-up. Remaining three panels are full-body FRONT, exact 90-degree SIDE facing image left, and BACK, all at identical scale with head and sole heights aligned. Every full body and every shoe is completely visible with generous top and bottom margins. Telephoto / near-orthographic appearance, straight verticals, no wide-angle perspective.
Maintain EXACT same identity, anatomy, hair silhouette, wardrobe, seams, accessories, colors and footwear across views. Clear natural face, neutral closed mouth expression; anatomically plausible hands with five fingers; believable eyes, ears, jaw and neck. Adult proportions around 7.5 heads, age-appropriate older or child proportions. Standing figures use neutral symmetrical relaxed A-pose, arms about 12 degrees from torso so arm/waist separation is visible, feet hip-width apart. Accessory hands can relax naturally to hold the stated prop. Seated wheelchair sheets instead show full seated human AND complete chair front, side and back, both wheels and footrests entirely in frame, hands and clothes unobstructed as far as physically possible.
Minimal typography only: small top-left ID/title and small panel captions 'FACE', 'FRONT', 'SIDE', 'BACK'. No decorative UI, no invented measurements, no anatomical labels, no branding, watermark, scenery, dramatic lighting, exaggerated muscles, giant heads, melted fingers or facial features.
Sheet title: "P00 | CASUAL MAN".
Subject: Fictional Hong Kong East Asian man, age 28, medium warm tan skin, short cropped black hair, lean average build. Teal short-sleeve cotton crewneck T-shirt, very dark navy jeans, off-white low-top trainers, charcoal backpack with two shoulder straps.
